source_snapshot.test_name: PCIE RAS Features - Uncorrectable error - Fatal
source_snapshot.purpose_facts: The row names a PCIe Surprise Down Error with uncorrectable-fatal severity on an unspecified NVIDIA CPU platform.
procedure_facts: Before-test text asks for recipe conformity and log clearing.
The entire during-test instruction is only `PCIE RAS Features - Surprise Down Error`.
After-test text requests results/photos and unexpected-log review.
missing_source_information: Whether the intended stimulus is an actual/equivalent link disappearance or only synthetic AER-status injection.
Exact NVIDIA platform, endpoint/downstream path, reporting Root Port/RCEC and AER/DPC ownership.
Generator, execution location, target coverage and destructive scope.
Expected fatal event, DPC/link/reset/host response, timeout and recovery outcome.
Data/traffic isolation, cold/warm recovery, restoration and pass/fail criteria.

original_test_intent.statement: Validate platform detection, fatal reporting, containment and owner-defined recovery for a PCIe Surprise Down condition on an approved NVIDIA CPU hierarchy; the current source does not define whether the link must actually disappear, which hierarchy is targeted or what fatal outcome is acceptable.
must_preserve: PCIe Surprise Down rather than Bad TLP, replay rollover or another AER error.
NVIDIA CPU platform after exact product identification.
must_not_infer: That a software-written AER status bit validates physical/equivalent link disappearance and containment.
That endpoint, downstream port, DPC containment port and AER reporting Root Port/RCEC share one BDF.
That host reboot/crash, DPC containment, link disable, device loss or automatic recovery is the expected result.
That the target may be a boot, storage, management, network or production-critical device.
That BERT, OS AER and BMC SEL all report every platform's fatal event.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 correctly identifies the label-only Procedure and TBD Criteria as a genuine blocker, requires topology/tool/fatal evidence and prohibits guessed injection.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 does not distinguish synthetic AER-status injection from an actual/equivalent Surprise Down stimulus, does not map DPC containment separately from AER reporting, and leaves the expected fatal link/device/host response too generic to prevent a reset or device loss from being accepted automatically.

related_records: Adjacent correctable Bad TLP and Replay Number Rollover cases have different severity, link behavior and recovery and cannot supply this fatal recipe.
applicable_history.precedence_application: The exact row fixes Surprise Down and fatal severity only. Its label-only procedure and TBD Criteria require owner resolution of stimulus fidelity, containment and recovery rather than analogy.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Maintain BLOCKED. Require the owner to choose a stimulus that actually exercises the requested Surprise Down path, map endpoint/link/DPC/AER loci, define the expected fatal containment and host state, and approve a recovery plan before any mutation.

conditions_present: Surprise Down error identity, uncorrectable-fatal severity, NV CPU PCIe context and 10/10-minute estimates are known.
missing: Stimulus fidelity, platform/topology/AER-DPC ownership, target/coverage, generator, fatal event and expected containment/host response, timeout, approvals, recovery and restoration.
provider: NVIDIA/ODM FAE supplies the platform PCIe RAS/DPC specification, supported Surprise Down stimulus and expected fatal response.
Test owner defines hierarchy coverage, event/containment criteria and completion state.
Device/network/storage/platform owners approve target isolation and data-loss scope; lab owner supplies console, power and recovery.
safe_read_only_work: Inventory endpoint, bridge, downstream/upstream/Root Port/RCEC BDFs, DPC/AER capabilities and ownership.
Record link speed/width/state, device/driver/service dependencies and existing AER/DPC counters/status without clearing them.
Export OS/BMC/firmware, storage/network/service and health baselines and exclude critical targets.
prohibited_until_resolved: Log/status clear, AER/DPC/configuration changes, hot removal/link disable, injector/exerciser actions, Surprise Down stimulus, reset/power cycle, retry, recovery or PASS/FAIL claim.
closure_evidence: Signed procedure proves the chosen stimulus exercises the required Surprise Down path and defines its execution location.
Each approved hierarchy maps target endpoint/link, containment port and reporting component with coverage.
Fatal event, DPC/link/device/host response, timeout, data/traffic impact, recovery and restoration criteria are approved and freshly reviewed.

revision_candidate.test_name: NVIDIA CPU PCIe Surprise Down Uncorrectable-Fatal Error - Definition Required
revision_candidate.purpose: After an authoritative recipe is supplied, create one bounded Surprise Down condition for each approved PCIe hierarchy target and verify the signed fatal AER/DPC reporting, containment and host response, followed by the prescribed recovery and restored platform health. The current row is not executable.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Unresolved. The owner must identify NVIDIA CPU/product, system/stepping, firmware, BIOS/BMC, OS/kernel, AER and DPC ownership, PCIe generation/topology, endpoints and a supported internal/vendor/external or physical-equivalent Surprise Down stimulus. Do not transfer another platform's hot-plug or injection recipe.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Unresolved per-hierarchy rows. Each future row must bind target endpoint, affected link, upstream/downstream ports, DPC containment port, AER reporting Root Port/RCEC, all BDFs, device role, data/traffic dependency and required iterations. Exclude boot, management and irreplaceable production/storage/network paths unless explicitly isolated and approved. Treat 10/10 minutes as estimates.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Exact platform/topology and AER/DPC ownership; authoritative NVIDIA/ODM/PCIe Surprise Down recipe; stimulus mechanism/tool/exerciser/hash and execution location; proof of stimulus fidelity; target/link/containment/reporter map and coverage; controlled traffic/data state; exact stimulus; expected fatal status/source/event and DPC/link/device/host transition; freshness/timeout; allowed reset or power behavior; console/power/recovery; data-integrity and service-health gates; baseline/clear policy; approvals; restoration.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: No Surprise Down stimulus is authorized while Criteria is TBD and Procedure is label-only. Perform only non-mutating topology, AER/DPC ownership/capability, dependency and health discovery. After the owner supplies the complete recipe, submit it for fresh V3 review; only that approved contract may define one bounded link-disappearance-equivalent stimulus, evidence correlation, containment, recovery and restoration.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Signed replacement Procedure/Criteria; exact platform, topology, AER/DPC loci, faithful stimulus, target/coverage and expected fatal state resolved; dedicated non-production SUT; target data/traffic isolated; stable baseline; console/OOB, boot media, power control, storage and recovery proven; every clear, configuration, stimulus, reset/power, retry and restoration approved.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Before authorization: signed platform/topology/stimulus-fidelity/fatal-response/evidence/safety/recovery contract. A future reviewed run requires identities/hashes; target/link/DPC/reporter map; dependency and baseline audit; AER/DPC capability/mask/status/counters and clear audit; exact stimulus/transcript and timeline; fresh target-correlated Surprise Down uncorrectable-fatal event within timeout; prescribed containment, link/device/host transition and allowed reset/power behavior; protected data/traffic outcome; recovery timeline; restored topology, link speed/width, device/service/system health and engineer disposition. BERT/BMC evidence is conditional on the recipe.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Not yet defined. The signed NVIDIA/ODM platform recipe and applicable PCIe AER/DPC specification must define the fatal response. Public Linux guidance treats fatal AER as an unreliable link requiring hierarchy recovery, while PCIe DPC can disable the downstream link for containment; neither selects the stimulus or acceptable host outcome for this unidentified platform.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not equate synthetic AER status with a real Surprise Down path without proof, infer BDF or containment locus, perform unapproved hot removal/link disable, target critical devices/traffic/data, assume DPC/reset/reboot/crash is PASS, clear evidence, change AER/DPC controls, inject, auto-retry, reset/power-cycle or restore before fresh review. Stop on wrong locus/severity, broader hierarchy loss, unexpected host reset/crash, boot failure, data corruption, uncontrolled service outage, failed containment or unrecoverable device/link state.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: NVIDIA/ODM FAE and test owner approve stimulus fidelity, fatal semantics, topology, coverage, DPC/AER evidence and expected host response. Device/network/storage/platform owners approve isolation and blast radius; lab owner approves SUT, console/power and recovery; fresh reviewer approves the executable contract. Qualified staff supervise every stimulus and recovery.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Before re-review, an Agent may only collect non-mutating topology, AER/DPC capability, dependency and health baselines. Humans own physical/external stimulus, target/data/traffic selection, configuration, approval, reset/power and recovery. Future Agent execution is defined only by the approved replacement; engineering retains disposition.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: No recovery action is authorized now because no stimulus is authorized. Preserve accidental-change evidence, isolate affected services and escalate. The replacement recipe must define DPC release or link/device reset, warm/cold/power recovery, boot fallback, data-integrity checks, AER/DPC restoration and final platform health before rerun.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Criteria remains TBD or Procedure label-only; stimulus fidelity, platform/topology/AER-DPC ownership/target/coverage/fatal response/timeout is unresolved; only synthetic or analogous documentation is available without owner approval; SUT/isolation/baseline/console/power/recovery/storage/restoration is missing; target or topology mismatches; or any unreviewed clear, hot removal/link disable, injection, reset/power or retry is proposed.

identified_defects: Criteria are TBD and Procedure is only a Surprise Down label.
The source does not say whether actual/equivalent link disappearance or synthetic status injection is intended.
Endpoint, link, DPC containment and AER reporting loci/coverage are missing.
V2 does not define which fatal link/device/host outcome is expected versus unsafe failure.
reason_for_change: Keep the genuine blocker while preventing a synthetic status-only test from masquerading as Surprise Down validation and requiring explicit containment, host-state and recovery acceptance for this fatal path.

new_technical_evidence.title: PCI Express Advanced Error Reporting Driver Guide HOWTO
new_technical_evidence.supports: Fatal AER indicates an unreliable link and Linux recovery operates on the hierarchy above the originating device, so reporter and affected target must be mapped and recovery cannot be inferred from one log.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The exact NVIDIA platform ownership, stimulus, fatal transition and recovery remain unspecified.

new_technical_evidence.title: Downstream Port Containment
new_technical_evidence.version: PCI-SIG ECN for PCI Express Base Specification 3.0
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Platforms and ports implementing applicable DPC capability
new_technical_evidence.supports: DPC can automatically disable the link below a Downstream Port after an uncorrectable error to contain propagation and support recovery.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The row does not identify DPC support, containment port, trigger policy or expected recovery.

new_technical_evidence.title: Source testcase Wistron-System RAS-00831-V002
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Only this Surprise Down fatal row
new_technical_evidence.supports: The Surprise Down label, fatal context, generic pre/post text, TBD Criteria and 10/10-minute estimates.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: All stimulus, topology, expected-state and recovery details are absent.

removed_ambiguities: Separates faithful link-disappearance-equivalent stimulus from synthetic AER status injection.
Maps endpoint, affected link, DPC containment port and AER reporter as distinct loci.
Requires owner-defined fatal DPC/link/device/host behavior rather than accepting any reset or loss.
remaining_blockers: Criteria, executable procedure, stimulus fidelity, platform/topology, AER/DPC loci, coverage, expected fatal state, timeout, approvals and recovery are unresolved; the test remains BLOCKED.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 retains the justified BLOCKED result while closing the largest false-validation path: a synthetic AER bit can no longer be claimed as proof of actual Surprise Down containment, and fatal recovery behavior must be explicitly signed.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The contract-only validator required proof that the future stimulus exercises Surprise Down rather than merely setting a fatal bit, kept endpoint/link/DPC/reporter loci separate, and refused to accept DPC disablement, reset, reboot or crash alone as success. It limited present work to read-only readiness discovery.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Reliability row 111 names PCIe Surprise Down as an uncorrectable-fatal case but provides only a label and TBD Criteria.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 correctly blocks execution but does not distinguish faithful Surprise Down from status-only simulation or define expected DPC/link/device/host behavior.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Allow only read-only topology/AER-DPC/dependency baselines; prohibit link disappearance, injection, clear or recovery until stimulus fidelity, expected fatal outcome and recovery pass fresh review.
